There's no blue pigment in blue eyes
There's no blue pigment in blue eyes
Every eye colour comes
from one brown pigment: melanin.
Blue eyes have almost
none in the front layer
of the iris.
Tiny fibres there
scatter light,
and blue scatters the most.
The dark back layer
soaks up the rest.
Add a little melanin,
and the eye looks green.
Add more, brown.
Blue eyes are blue
the way the sky is blue.
